core_shift: The response is no longer a single C/S category or total niche breadth. The programme separates recurrent global colour geography, species-specific spatial structure, ecological/geographic concordance, and between-species community assembly.

current_questions.G1: Is there a recurrent flower-colour discontinuity field shared across adequately replicated species?
current_questions.G2: If so, is that field stable enough to define neutral recurrent zones Z01, Z02, ...?
current_questions.G3: Regardless of G1, which external ecological or geographic contrasts align with within-species colour discontinuity after controlling geographic distance?
current_questions.G4: If G1+G2 pass, which independently frozen external surfaces annotate the recurrent zones?
current_questions.G5: Are sympatric plant species more colour-convergent or colour-divergent than outcome-blind matched allopatric controls, and which contexts explain the sign?

legacy_hypothesis_mapping.claim_limit: environmental concordance, not morph-specific fitness or local adaptation

legacy_hypothesis_mapping.best_v2_test: only when independent spatial herbivore/florivore interaction data reach adequate coverage

legacy_hypothesis_mapping.rule: spatial colour structure is phenotypic geography unless heritability/genetic basis is independently established

priority_order: complete metadata discovery and capacity gates without colour-driven changes
execute G1-G3 with distance-controlled external alignment including edaphic turnover
if G1+G2 pass, annotate neutral Z zones with G4 overlays
execute G5 matched sympatry/allopatry assembly on the same location-blind species colour profiles
only then open targeted temporal, reproductive, genetic or fitness studies needed for causal mechanism claims
